# In the Binder

> In the Binder is a free Android app for trading card collectors, currently in beta on Google Play. It scans cards with the phone camera, files them into binders set by set, checks centring before grading (PSA, BGS, CGC limits), reads graded slabs and shows what a collection is worth. It works offline.

- Platform: Android (Google Play beta). iPhone version planned. A free web version at https://inthebinder.com/app/ works on any computer or phone: it opens the app's backup file (collection, value over time, grading picks, centring on a photo) and keeps it in the browser.
- Price: free.
- Card languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish, German, Japanese, Korean, Chinese.
- Privacy: card recognition runs on the phone; photos are not uploaded.
- Independent app, not affiliated with Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK, The Pokémon Company or Wizards of the Coast.
- Contact: support@inthebinder.com
